Q1/Q3 facts: core/Session/Session.js is a plain class (not an Item) = dated-folder locator only; AISession extends Session; AISessionDetail extends Page draws it. Page tools (Servex/agents/page_tools.js) are 5 tools all hard-wired to page.jsonl (resolve_file:50); page_set already takes method-as-key deltas, page_call takes an explicit method param

Q1 answer: Item (core/Item/Item.js) = id + data bag + set(delta)/apply + get/locate + lists()/walk/find + Events + optional Store (one .jsonl: replay, append via FsFile.send, tail). Page extends Item and adds url/name, pages List, children Map, content List, store=PageLogReader of page.jsonl, settings, six layout words, tab/file lines, routing and render. Item runs in node; Page does not (imports View, reads location)

Q3 proposal: Session extends Item and HAS a page (page.jsonl in the same folder). Each Item class names its log file (static file: page.jsonl / session.jsonl / task.jsonl). session.jsonl is written by the harness only (law 7); page.jsonl is drawn by agents. One item({path, method, target, args}) tool resolves path -> folder -> class -> file; page_* tools stay as aliases. Server side: server-instance.md PageDoc generalises to ItemDoc. Alternative (Session extends Page, accounting R13) is blocked until the Page state/view split (split-plan.md)

Q4 conflicts with helper-accounting shape: R13 says Session extends Page (vs extends Item); usage.jsonl as a separate file (vs a usage line kind in session.jsonl); otherwise aligned (R11 rename, subsessions/ tasks/ folders, requirement 8 one-tool surface). Sent the five points to helper-accounting, awaiting its reply
